name: R8 Seq 8: Table 3.9, Stages f1 f2 f3 f4

reference.note: The thesis's Eq 3.59 undercounts scrap in a Stage of 3 or more Features, so the engine is lower than the printed E(PR) by about 2e-4; the tolerance allows for it (D1, ADR 0001). Table 3.9 prints E(PR) − I 0.5 too high for this Sequence (D10b). Table 3.9 prints I = 3; one Stage of 4 Features gives 0.5 + 4 × 0.5 = 2.5 (D10a). The printed f4 mean is a little off the optimum (D19). Each Stage's Scrap Cost is cumulative: the Scrap Costs of every Feature made so far (C9). Inspection Cost is 0.5 + 0.5 per Feature after each Stage; the reference is E(PR) before it.
